# Rust runtime notices

These unmodified notices come from the installed Rust 1.98.1 toolchain,
commit 48a229ceaefd4985c50990b14116b6d856af0985, x86_64-pc-windows-gnu.
COPYRIGHT-library.html records the standard library and its bundled components;
licenses/ preserves the toolchain's full license texts. Compiler-only binaries
are not being bundled by Tickx.

For each public release, verify the helper's actual Rust compiler version and
refresh these records if it differs. This snapshot does not certify which
compiler produced any older binary. Cargo package notices are kept separately
in ../wellen-licenses.
